adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the category is now derived from the per-host record: `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host` returns nil/false (no matching configured host), `try(:category_id)` yields nil, which would change behavior vs the prior `category: SiteSetting.embed_category` (and that setting is removed in this diff). The added spec only covers the matched-host case and asserts the category equals `embeddable_host.category` (spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb), but there is no test covering the nil/“unmatched host” branch. This is a concrete, diff-grounded missing-test/edge-case coverage issue, not a proven runtime defect from the diff alone.
